name: reasoning-v1
description: R2-08 fixed analytical/multi-step reasoning workload (frozen for routing drift analysis).

dev.prompt: Solve step by step. A workshop has three machines A, B, and C producing the same part. In one hour A makes 24 parts, B makes 18 parts, and C makes 30 parts. The defect rates are 2% for A, 3% for B, and 1% for C. (1) If the workshop runs all three machines for 5 hours, how many total parts are produced and what is the expected number of defective parts? (2) If one part is selected uniformly at random from that 5-hour production and found defective, what is the probability it came from machine B? Show all calculations and justify each step.
